entities.summary: Tivoli Gardens is a historic amusement destination in Copenhagen, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A rare historic amusement garden where rides, landscaping, architecture and evening atmosphere work as one coherent destination. This entry is intended for 4–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
